findingsAddressed: operative-state.ts cross-document definition fallback (contributing to P0-2's family)

p02Remediation.rootCause: persistStructuralDefinitions/persistDefinedTerms computed stableKey as computeStableKey('defined-term', companyId, normalizedTerm) - omitting documentId. Two documents' definitions of the same term collided onto one @@unique([companyId, stableKey]) row; the upsert's update branch touched sourceNodeId/definitionTextRef but never documentId, producing an internally contradictory row (documentId=Facility-A, sourceNodeId->Facility-B).
p02Remediation.fix: stableKey now includes documentId: computeStableKey('defined-term', companyId, documentId, normalizedTerm) - making each row a genuine physical definition occurrence, matching DocumentNode's charStart and ContractRule's sourceDocumentId disambiguators. No schema change needed for this specific fix.
p02Remediation.identityModelClarified: Separated: (a) term LEXICAL identity (the normalized string), (b) a PHYSICAL DEFINITION OCCURRENCE (document/instrument-scoped), (c) document identity, (d) instrument identity, (e) the SEMANTIC RESOLUTION TARGET a consumer wants in a given context. A legal term string is no longer conflated with a single global physical occurrence ID.
p02Remediation.relatedFallbackFix: operative-state.ts's resolveBaseText DEFINITION branch changed from `index.getDefinition(group.ref, baseDocumentId) ?? index.getDefinition(group.ref)` to `index.getDefinition(group.ref, baseDocumentId)` (no fallback) - the no-documentId fallback was the same root defect class one layer up, silently matching an unrelated document's same-named definition. This is a narrow, single-line fix; Workstream D's own targetResolutionStatus gate (see 04-operative-state-remediation.json) layers on top of it independently.

beforeAfterProofRealPostgres.before: Two facilities, same company, both defining 'Payment Conditions': one row survives, documentId=Alpha, sourceNodeId resolves into Beta's document.
beforeAfterProofRealPostgres.after: Two distinct rows: { documentId: 'facility-alpha', stableKey: 'defined-term:e4de5a8b...', sourceNodeId resolves into facility-alpha } and { documentId: 'facility-beta', stableKey: 'defined-term:1b6a9499...', sourceNodeId resolves into facility-beta } - every row's own documentId now agrees with its own sourceNodeId's document by construction.

p19Remediation.rootCause: persistStructuralNodes/persistStructuralDefinitions/persistContractRules/persistDefinedTerms/persistStructuralReferences were all upsert-only, never deleting rows for content the current run no longer produces.
p19Remediation.designChosen: Upsert-then-prune, in a single DB transaction, for all five functions: for every document actually represented in the current call's input, delete any previously-persisted row for that (companyId, documentId) whose stableKey the current run did not reproduce.
p19Remediation.designRationale: Chosen over a version/isCurrent column because it requires no schema change (beyond the separate stableKey addition to ContractReferenceEdge, which had NO identity at all before), preserves row identity/FK links across a legitimate unchanged re-run, and gives a real DB-enforced atomic guarantee.
p19Remediation.failClosedGuard: An empty candidate array never triggers a tombstone (cannot distinguish genuinely-zero from an upstream failure producing nothing) - only non-empty runs may prune.
p19Remediation.additionalDefectFound: persistStructuralReferences had ZERO identity at all before this fix (.create() only, no stableKey column existed on ContractReferenceEdge) - every replay literally duplicated every edge. Added a stableKey column (nullable, since the separate LLM-candidate creator persistReferences never sets it and Postgres treats multiple NULLs as non-colliding), converted to upsert, added the same tombstone step.

p11Remediation.rootCause: semantic/compile.ts's module-level defaultCache singleton (used by every real current caller omitting options.cache) is keyed by cache.ts's computeCacheKey, which never included companyId/instrumentKey/sourceDocumentId.
p11Remediation.fix: Added companyId, instrumentKey, sourceDocumentId to computeCacheKey's hash. Design decision: extended the flat key rather than building a per-tenant cache-scope wrapper, since a wrapper would only earn its complexity for a future per-tenant eviction/quota need that doesn't exist yet.

p12Remediation.fix: Added ContractReferenceEdge.targetTermId/targetDocumentNodeId (audit-named) plus targetDocumentId (found by mechanical sweep), AmendmentEffect.targetRuleId/targetTermId/targetDocumentNodeId (found by sweep), DebtInstrument.baseDocumentId, Document.instrumentId.
